rfis.subject: Structural Curb Opening Dimensions vs. M-201 Ductwork Penetration
rfis.question: Drawing S-102 shows a 48"x60" roof opening for the RTU, but Mechanical M-201 requires 54"x72" to accommodate supply/return plenum transitions. Please confirm revised structural header framing.
rfis.official_response: Proceed with enlarged 54"x72" curb opening. Add two W8x15 structural cross-angles per revised detail S-102-R1 attached. Submit Change Event for added steel framing.

rfis.subject: Sanitary Sewer Elevation Discrepancy
rfis.question: Civil sheet C-102 shows invert elevation at 102.5ft, but Plumbing sheet P-101 indicates connection at 104.2ft. Please confirm correct invert elevation.
rfis.suggestion: Adjust plumbing invert to match civil site utility at 102.5ft with 1% slope.
